original_query: with inv as (select w_warehouse_name,w_warehouse_sk,i_item_sk,d_moy        ,stdev,mean, case mean when 0 then null else stdev/mean end cov  from(select w_warehouse_name,w_warehouse_sk,i_item_sk,d_moy             ,stddev_samp(inv_quantity_on_hand) stdev,avg(inv_quantity_on_hand) mean       from inventory           ,item           ,warehouse           ,date_dim       where inv_item_sk = i_item_sk         and inv_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk         and inv_date_sk = d_date_sk         and d_year =2000         and i_category IN ('Books', 'Men')         and i_manager_id BETWEEN 81 and 100         and inv_quantity_on_hand between 376 and 576       group by w_warehouse_name,w_warehouse_sk,i_item_sk,d_moy) foo  where case mean when 0 then 0 else stdev/mean end > 1) select inv1.w_warehouse_sk,inv1.i_item_sk,inv1.d_moy,inv1.mean, inv1.cov         ,inv2.w_warehouse_sk,inv2.i_item_sk,inv2.d_moy,inv2.mean, inv2.cov from inv inv1,inv inv2 where inv1.i_item_sk = inv2.i_item_sk   and inv1.w_warehouse_sk =  inv2.w_warehouse_sk   and inv1.d_moy=1   and inv2.d_moy=1+1 order by inv1.w_warehouse_sk,inv1.i_item_sk,inv1.d_moy,inv1.mean,inv1.cov         ,inv2.d_moy,inv2.mean, inv2.cov ;
rewritten_query:
WITH inv_stats AS (
    SELECT
        w.w_warehouse_sk,
        i.i_item_sk,
        AVG(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) FILTER (WHERE d.d_moy = 1) AS mean_1,
        STDDEV_SAMP(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) FILTER (WHERE d.d_moy = 1) AS stdev_1,
        AVG(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) FILTER (WHERE d.d_moy = 2) AS mean_2,
        STDDEV_SAMP(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) FILTER (WHERE d.d_moy = 2) AS stdev_2
    FROM inventory inv
    JOIN item i ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2000
      AND d.d_moy IN (1, 2)
      AND i.i_category IN ('Books', 'Men')
      AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 81 AND 100
      AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand BETWEEN 376 AND 576
    GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_sk, i.i_item_sk
)
SELECT
    w_warehouse_sk,
    i_item_sk,
    1 AS d_moy,
    mean_1 AS mean,
    CASE mean_1 WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE stdev_1 / mean_1 END AS cov,
    w_warehouse_sk,
    i_item_sk,
    2 AS d_moy,
    mean_2 AS mean,
    CASE mean_2 WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE stdev_2 / mean_2 END AS cov
FROM inv_stats
WHERE CASE mean_1 WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE stdev_1 / mean_1 END > 1
  AND CASE mean_2 WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE stdev_2 / mean_2 END > 1
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8, 9, 10;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Pushed d_moy IN (1,2) into the aggregation: the original CTE aggregates all 12 months of year 2000, but only months 1 and 2 are used. This cuts aggregated input by roughly 6x (rewrite score 9/10).

Replaced the materialized, self-joined CTE with conditional aggregation (FILTER clauses): one single-reference CTE is inlined by PostgreSQL, eliminating CTE materialization and the self-join (rewrite score 8/10).

Removed unused w_warehouse_name from GROUP BY (functionally dependent on w_warehouse_sk); kept the warehouse join only for referential filtering. Equivalent given the primary key (rewrite score 4/10).

Converted comma joins to explicit INNER JOINs; join order/semantics preserved. Index suggestions: date_dim(d_year,d_moy,d_date_sk), item(i_category,i_manager_id,i_item_sk) (rewrite score 2/10 readability; 7/10 physical).
Folded inv2.d_moy = 1+1 into the constant 2 and materialized month-1/month-2 as constant output columns; equivalence holds because d_moy is already restricted to (1,2).
